metaTitle: Clinic & Hospital Management Software in Ranchi | Lucoze
metaDescription: Lucoze runs Ranchi clinics and nursing homes: Lalpur to Bariatu, with records, GST billing, lab and pharmacy in one place. ABDM-ready, DPDP 2023, data in India.
lead: For Ranchi's nursing homes, diagnostic centres and specialty clinics — patient records, appointments, GST billing, lab and pharmacy on one platform your front desk can actually run.
intro: Ranchi is where Jharkhand's private healthcare is growing fastest — nursing homes along Kanke Road, the Bariatu hospital belt, diagnostic centres and specialty clinics opening across Lalpur and Harmu. Most are still running a paper file, a separate billing register and a lab pad that never quite agree. Lucoze pulls records, appointments, GST billing, lab reports and pharmacy stock onto one screen. The front desk finds a patient by name, UHID, ABHA number or mobile, and the ABHA number is recorded at the first visit so it is on file from day one instead of being chased later.
points: One platform for a growing practice
Records, appointments, GST billing, lab and pharmacy in one place — so a busy Lalpur or Bariatu clinic isn't re-keying patients across registers.

Record the ABHA number at the first visit and keep claims tidy for Ayushman Bharat (PMJAY) and state schemes.
A front desk that learns it fast

Reminders for patients who travel far
WhatsApp reminders for appointments, set up for your clinic during onboarding, cut wasted trips for patients coming in from the districts around Ranchi.
localContext: In a Ranchi nursing home off Kanke Road or a clinic in the Bariatu belt, the front desk runs in Hindi and the same patient gets spelt three ways — once in the register, once on the bill, once on the lab slip. Diagnostic centres in Lalpur and clinics around Harmu have the same split-record problem. Patients speak Hindi and often Santhali, Nagpuri or Khortha, so names rarely land the same twice. Lucoze keeps one record per patient, found by mobile number, UHID or ABHA number as well as name, and GST billing matches how Ranchi practices actually invoice. Support is remote-first from our team in Konnagar, Hooghly, with on-site help for hospital-scale rollouts. As the capital and a growing tier-2 hub, Ranchi is the referral point for a wide rural catchment, so many patients travel in from surrounding districts for a single appointment — WhatsApp reminders, set up during onboarding, cut the wasted trips when a slot moves. Billing fits a cash-and-UPI counter rather than assuming cards, and running the clinic and its pharmacy on one system means a patient who came a long way isn't sent back for a second queue.

faqs.q: Do you come to our clinic in Ranchi to set it up?
faqs.a: Our team is based in Konnagar, Hooghly (West Bengal), so Ranchi onboarding is remote-first — video setup, we migrate your data, and WhatsApp and phone support. For hospital-scale deployments we arrange on-site visits.

faqs.q: Can our staff use it easily?
faqs.a: Yes. The screens are in English, with short plain labels, and onboarding trains your staff on your own patients. Search by name, UHID, ABHA number or mobile finds the record.

faqs.q: Where does our patient data live?
faqs.a: In Indian data centres, DPDP 2023 compliant, with no lock-in — export to CSV or PDF whenever you want. Try it free for 14 days and you can be live in around 14 days.

faqs.q: Many of our patients come from outside Ranchi — can the system help them?
faqs.a: Yes. WhatsApp reminders for appointments are set up for your clinic during onboarding, so patients travelling in from surrounding districts don't make a wasted trip. Billing works for a cash-and-UPI counter, and because the clinic and pharmacy share one system, someone who came a long way isn't sent to a second queue for their medicines.
